budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: DRIVE-S81-SLICEP 10-20 s81sl_lepwmu_d1a: DIAGNOSTIC stand-in parent of the MU die master dsdv_slice_lepw_mu (never bindable), recipe of s81sl_lepenh_d3a (see tools/s81_slice/mk_lepmu_kits.py): S = slice, K = MU endpoint + CLOSED dsdv_mu_land view + 2 tf-less lanes, rings only at S<->K; a: port flops unanchored, PD 0.45.
